messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — Severity: HIGH. Metric: 5xx ratio on /v1/embeddings > 3% (us-east-1). Start: 23:41 UTC. Pager: @alex (oncall). Incident ID: INC-1789001234. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-1789001234

alex (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge in 30s. Posting initial mitigations here so it's in thread.

alex (oncall): bridge: https://meet.example/room/INC-1789001234 (joined)

sre-jordan: grabbing node metrics now. I see repeated kernel OOMs on gpu-12-3 around 23:42. Kernel messages: `nvml: out-of-memory` (attached logs). Suspect batch size blowup + KV cache pressure.

maya (support): Customer reports: customer-acme reported 500s starting 23:41, high priority CSM alerted. Also seeing public status page noise — posting customer-facing blurb draft shortly.

ben (eng): FYI: we rolled a quantized embedding model (embed-q-v2) to 20% at 23:30. Will check rollout logs to see if traffic split overlaps.

alex (oncall): Immediate mitigation: 1) scale serving pool down to smaller batch size on pool-embeddings-us-east, 2) enable fallback route to cpu-embed for affected API keys, 3) temporarily pause embed-q-v2 rollout (evict from serving). Executing now.

alex (oncall): commands I ran: ```
# reduce batch size
curl -X POST "$ADMIN/api/pools/pool-embeddings-us-east/config" -d '{"max_batch_size":64}'
# evict variant
./ctl rollout pause embed-q-v2 --region us-east-1
# enable fallback rule
./ctl routing add-fallback --route /v1/embeddings --target cpu-embeddings
```

ops-bot: Action executed: scale config update queued (job 4521). Fallback rule added. Rollout pause acknowledged.

sre-jordan: After fallback and batch size reduction, error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 0.9% within two minutes. CPU fallback increases latency ~40ms for some requests but keeps success rate stable. Monitoring for a full recovery window.

maya (support): Customer communications: sent initial note to affected customers at 23:47 UTC. Template: "We're investigating elevated errors with embeddings in us-east-1; mitigation in progress; no data loss expected." CSMs copied.

kate (product): Customer impact: estimate ~30% of embedding traffic for a subset of customers (0.6% of total revenue) experienced elevated errors between 23:41-23:47. Need to validate billing/credits for those keys.

ben (eng): root-candidate: model variant introduced quantization codepath which increases transient memory. If quantized kernel handles KV cache differently, could explain OOMs. Collecting model runtime traces.

alex (oncall): Handoff: I'm going to hand this to @sre-jordan for the next shift. I'm adding runbook notes and starting a post-incident doc. Handoff notes below.

alex (oncall): Handoff notes: - Incident mitigated by 23:47 via rollback + fallback. - Current state: stable, error rate <1% for 10m. - Keep embed-q-v2 paused. - Need: full timeline, model rollout traffic, kernel OOM stack traces, GPU telemetry, and customer error keys.

sre-jordan: Taking over monitoring and RCA. I'll collect kernel dumps and coordinate with ben on model traces. Planned immediate tasks: 1) snapshot OOM logs (`journalctl -u runtime-gpu --since "23:30" --until "00:00" > /tmp/ooms.log`), 2) pull rollout events (`./ctl rollout history embed-q-v2 --json > /tmp/rollout.json`), 3) fetch per-api-key error rates from analytics.

alex (oncall): Thanks — I'm adding action items and owners. Also scheduling postmortem sync.

alex (oncall): Postmortem sync proposal: 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC (30m). Invite: @sre-jordan, @ben (eng), @kate (product), @maya (support), @security for data handling. If that doesn't work, next slot 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC.

ben (eng): I'll prepare a short model-change summary and attach rollout diffs to the doc.

maya (support): I'll compile affected customer list + support tickets. Need timeline for when to offer credits.

kate (product): I'll own the impact summary and coordinate customer comms with legal.

alex (oncall): Action items (short):
- Collect kernel OOM traces + GPU telemetry — owner: sre-jordan — due: 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC
- Export rollout history & config diffs for embed-q-v2 — owner: ben (eng) — due: 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC
- Aggregate per-key error rates & affected keys — owner: alex (oncall) — due: 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC
- Compile customer impact & tickets — owner: maya (support) — due: 2026-03-16 09:00 UTC
- Draft postmortem start (RCA doc) with timeline template — owner: alex (oncall) — due: 2026-03-16 12:00 UTC

alex (oncall): RCA draft expectations: timeline, contributing factors, mitigation timeline, customer impact summary, action items, and acceptance criteria for closure. Requesting peer review from @kate and @ben before sign-off.

sre-jordan: I'll put the initial evidence (logs + traces) into the doc and tag reviewers. Also enable additional trace retention for related spans.

ops-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc link using template: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortem/template — created: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortem/INC-1789001234-draft (alex).

alex (oncall): Draft created and shared. Please add any preliminary notes inline.

kate (product): I can review the RCA draft tomorrow morning and aim to sign off after engineering validation. Please @me when ready.

ben (eng): If the model variant is the root cause, we should add a rollout safety check (memory-pressure gate) and adjust the canary traffic rules. Adding as an action item: "add memory-pressure gating to rollout controller" — owner: ben — due 2026-03-23.

maya (support): Noted. Will follow up with CSMs to confirm compensation approach after we finalize impact numbers.

alex (oncall): Final notes before I step off: keep embed-q-v2 paused until we have a clear repro and fixes. If error rate resurges >2% or any customer reports data loss, escalate to incident channel and page SRE lead.

sre-jordan: Acknowledged. Taking over monitoring and the RCA. I'll post a status update in 1h or earlier if anything changes.

ops-bot: Incident status updated to: MONITORED (stable). Incident owner: sre-jordan.

alex (oncall): Thanks team — great coordination. :white_check_mark:

sre-jordan: starting evidence collection now. tagging reviewers once initial timeline is in the doc.

(End of thread)
